name: Dried persimmon
summary: Persimmon dried until chewy, listed beside the wind-dried fruit as a Da Lat thing to carry home.
origin: Vietnam Tourism lists dried persimmons among Da Lat persimmon specialties. The provincial innovation center describes hồng sấy dẻo as favored in highlands such as Da Lat.
texture: The innovation center says the fruit is dried in open air or cold-dried so it stays chewy.
howToEat: Eat it as a sweet to take home. Vietnam Tourism’s rural desk describes a taste of fragrant dried persimmon at a seasonal fair in a Cam Ly resort yard.
where: Persimmon orchards at the end of Mimosa Pass, and shops in town. A street number for a dried-persimmon counter is Check on arrival. The Cam Ly fair is periodic. Hours are Check on arrival.
